basic_profile.bio: A horror movie enthusiast from Seattle, I've been obsessed with all things undead since I was a kid. My day job as a graphic designer gives me the flexibility to dive deep into Reddit, especially at night when the world quiets down. Single and loving it, I spend my weekends binge-watching zombie films and exploring niche horror comics. I’m still getting used to the Reddit community but I love connecting with fellow horror fans. My online hours are mostly late at night due to my nocturnal lifestyle.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have over 30 years of self-taught expertise in zombie and horror films, stemming from a childhood fascination. My knowledge is mostly acquired through extensive viewing, reading, and engaging with fan communities.
